# Quietly, for Dottie

*Winnie knows Dottie's lamb Button is missing, though Dottie has told no one. Follow the large, round, damp tracks from the bramble at the woods' edge into Windflower Glade, defeat 40 Windflower Caps and find a tuft of speckled wool. Dottie must not learn Winnie sent you.*

|  |  |

## Objectives

1. Reach [Windflower Glade](../maps/windflower_glade.md)
2. Defeat 40 [Windflower Cap](../monsters/windflower_cap.md)
3. Deliver 1 [Tuft of Speckled Wool](../items/speckled_wool_tuft.md)

## Rewards

- 22,000 EXP
- 4,500 mesos
- [Elixir](../items/elixir.md) x2
- +40 standing with Kaldemor
